PreceptDef.label: divine silicon
PreceptDef.description: Colonists feel spiritually connected to technology and believe that 'machine spirits' animate all machines.

li.label: no machinery
li.description: There is no sacred machinery nearby. We languish without the touch of the machine spirits.

li.label: Little machinery
li.description: There is only a little machinery nearby. We are not nurturing the machine spirits enough!

li.label: Some machinery
li.description: There is a decent amount of sacred machinery nearby, as there should be.

li.label: Abundant machinery
li.description: It is comforting to be around the living machine spirits in such numbers.
